items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch, public beta, public data display, alert expansion, affiliate or advertising expansion, and external outreach. Conditional only for ordinary reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private; retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked; keep outreach unsent; continue bounded read-only evidence work. Evidence: upstream API access is documented, but rights to store, derive, display, cache, alert on, or monetize the data are not established; four legal launch tasks remain open; accuracy, freshness, security, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete; compliance is technical-only with 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown; operations and fleet-doctor sweeps have no results; revenue is limited to 2026-09-21 aggregate commission and is not site-attributable. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, and any affiliate or advertising use.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active. Progress: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed; 4 remain open: searchwoot-legal-source-rights, searchwoot-data-flow-retention, searchwoot-ga4-consent-evidence, and searchwoot-logs-vendors-incident. Existing progress includes official API, terms, support, repository/configuration, privacy, cookie-policy, and private-gate evidence, but no task is closable. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage, caching, display, derivatives, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures.

Data-use review dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data: counsel_required. Missing current written permission or API agreement, field-level rights, permitted storage/caching/display/derivative/alert use, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark/image/price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results: evidence_needed. Missing data inventory, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce the repository and deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics: evidence_needed. Missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional treatment. Smallest next action: capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking or advertising. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data: evidence_needed. Missing log-field inventory, retention and access controls, vendor/DPA review, incident handling, and data-request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory and identify counsel-required gaps.

Private-site decision: retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked. Their scaffold or parked state, missing analytics, and unreachable compliance evidence do not support public launch or monetization. Next evidence action for each site: complete a timestamped checklist covering reachability, content, disclosures, consent and cookie behavior, privacy and terms, analytics, monetization, claims, provenance, copyright/trademark, platform policy, and age-sensitive concerns where applicable, then record exactly one disposition: retain parked or bounded launch. Do not expose or monetize before completion.
